column3: The approval preview runs the canonical arguments through a new kernel secrets.redact before the 500-character cap; the facade exposes redact (not values) to rows holding secrets, and the policy row declares secrets
column4: XIN-32's review of #102: a stored secret in a held call's arguments reached the request doc, the journal, request.list and socket frames verbatim. Redacting before the cut stops a cap from splitting a value and leaking its half. redact reuses redaction.ts, so there is one implementation, and rows still never read a value. The grant keeps the unredacted canonical arguments to match the exact call, which the transcript's own tool call already holds
